title: Anaemia (Anemia): Symptoms, Causes, Haemoglobin Levels and India's NFHS-5 Data
seoTitle: Anemia Symptoms and Causes: Hb Levels, India Data
seoDescription: Anaemia means low haemoglobin. Signs: tiredness, breathlessness, pale skin. Causes: low iron, B12 or folate, worms, heavy periods, blood disorders.
excerpt: WHO's 2024 haemoglobin cut-offs in g/dL, NFHS-5 figures for Indian children, women and men, why vegetarians should think about B12, what Anaemia Mukt Bharat offers, and the warning signs that need a doctor.
